en.h1: From carrying the decision alone to leading it.
en.lede: Bring one live business issue and, across 6 months, work it into a written action plan your team can act on, with faculty and coaches reviewing your reasoning. The method stays with you. [ABC_PROFILE.programmePositioning: positioning + not-an-MQA-degree boundary]

ms.h1: Daripada memikul keputusan sendirian kepada memimpin pelaksanaannya.
ms.lede: Bawa satu isu perniagaan sebenar dan, sepanjang 6 bulan, ubahnya menjadi pelan tindakan bertulis yang boleh dilaksanakan oleh pasukan anda. Fasilitator dan jurulatih menyemak cara anda berfikir, dan kaedah itu kekal bersama anda. leftForReviewer: Owner decision §14.2 says wherever the certificate/CMI is named in the hero or first viewport, CERTIFICATE_POSITIONING.professionalRelevance must render in the same block, joining supporting line 2 for the home hero. FutureCommerceHome's actual hero JSX only has three short stat-fact fragments (duration/recognition badge/cohort count), not full sentences, so there is no room to add the professionalRelevance sentence inside the hero fold without touching JSX structure — which the unit brief forbids. I placed the certificate distinction + professionalRelevance pairing in the 'recognition' section instead (same page, later block, both languages) and did not restructure the hero. This is the same structural gap the hero-review-ms.json review flagged as unresolved between spec §9 and §12 item 4, and it should be escalated to the owner/reviewer rather than resolved unilaterally, per that review's own methodology note.

Malay 'kohort Bahasa Inggeris' / 'Bahasa Inggeris' label capitalisation inside a short tag (languageName helper, factCommunity) was left unchanged — pre-existing pattern, not full-sentence body prose, so the register guide's lowercase-in-running-prose rule arguably doesn't apply, but flagging for the reviewer's judgement.

The three-language hero A/B alternative (spec §9 'Bring one real decision. Leave with the method.') was not implemented anywhere on this page — only the primary hero exists in FutureCommerceHome.tsx, matching current component structure; no A/B test scaffold exists to attach it to.
